topic.title: Generative Policies and Diffusion-Based Planning
topic.overview: Generative models can represent distributions over trajectories or structured solutions rather than choose one action at a time. This topic studies how diffusion and related sequence models are guided toward high-value, feasible behavior. Learning the starting distribution, modifying sampling, and choosing a generation order are alternative ways to influence the final plan.
topic.whyItMatters: A plausible trajectory is not necessarily executable or rewarding. Guidance must improve decisions without causing distribution drift or making inference so expensive that the planner loses its practical advantage.
topic.evolution: Earlier representatives frame data generation as sequential decision-making. Later work develops diffusion planners, shortcut sampling, and infeasibility detection. Recent methods optimize latent priors, analyze likelihood estimation in reinforcement learning, and learn variable-length insertion orders, widening the forms of structured generation available for planning and combinatorial tasks.
openQuestions: How can a planner certify feasibility while sampling from a learned generative prior?
When is learning a better proposal more effective than correcting samples afterward?

papers.tldr: MMD Guidance adapts diffusion sampling toward a reference distribution without retraining, with experiments showing alignment gains while preserving sample fidelity.

papers.title: Model-Based Diffusion Sampling for Predictive Control in Offline Decision Making
papers.tldr: MPDiffuser interleaves task planning with learned dynamics corrections to improve diffusion-generated control trajectories on benchmarks and a quadrupedal robot.

papers.title: Multi-Objective Learning for Diffusion Models: A Statistical Theory under Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.tldr: Training specialists before distilling a generalist yields diffusion-learning bounds whose paired-data requirements depend on specialist complexity.

papers.title: Offline Preference Optimization for Rectified Flow with Noise-Tracked Pairs
papers.tldr: PNAPO records the initial noises behind image preference pairs to improve rectified-flow alignment while reducing training computation.

papers.title: Open Materials Generation with Inference-Time Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: OMatG-IRL applies inference-time reinforcement learning directly to crystal generators’ velocity fields, improving objective alignment and sampling efficiency.

papers.title: Optimal Transport for LLM Reward Modeling from Noisy Feedback
papers.tldr: SelectiveRM uses partial optimal transport to exclude semantically inconsistent feedback while training language-model reward models.

papers.title: Optimal Transport–Guided Stochastic Control for Graph Combinatorial Optimization
papers.tldr: The method combines an exact continuous relaxation with optimal-transport-guided learned sampling to improve graph optimization.

papers.title: Optimizing Visual Generative Models via Distribution-wise Rewards
papers.tldr: Distribution-level rewards improve visual generation quality while helping preserve diversity during reinforcement-learning fine-tuning.

papers.title: Personalized Image Generation via Human-in-the-loop Bayesian Optimization
papers.tldr: MultiBO uses repeated user preferences among generated images to move closer to an imagined target after language prompting becomes difficult.

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction
papers.tldr: GILC guides discrete diffusion generation by correcting prediction logits, supporting varied rewards without additional training.

papers.title: Reasoning on the Manifold: Bidirectional Consistency for Self-Verification in Diffusion Language Models
papers.tldr: A masking-and-reconstruction consistency score helps diffusion language models assess reasoning, guide resampling, and obtain finer-grained alignment rewards.

papers.title: Rethinking the Design Space of Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: On the Importance of Likelihood Estimation Beyond Loss Design
papers.tldr: The study finds that ELBO-based likelihood estimation matters more than policy-gradient loss choice for efficient diffusion-model RL in its evaluations.

papers.title: SIPO: Stabilized and Improved Preference Optimization for Aligning Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: SIPO stabilizes diffusion preference training through timestep clipping, masking, and importance reweighting.

papers.title: Spectral Evolution Search: Efficient Inference-Time Scaling for Reward-Aligned Image Generation
papers.tldr: Spectral Evolution Search improves reward-aligned image generation by focusing initial-noise search on influential low-frequency directions.

papers.title: Spectral Guidance for Flexible and Efficient Control of Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Spectral Guidance learns noise-relevant features that enable flexible diffusion control with faster sampling and no denoiser backpropagation during sampling.

papers.title: Stein Diffusion Guidance: Training-Free Posterior Correction for Sampling Beyond High-Density Regions
papers.tldr: Stein Diffusion Guidance corrects approximate posteriors without additional training, with experiments suggesting improved guidance in low-density regions.

papers.title: TDM-R1: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models with Non-Differentiable Reward
papers.tldr: TDM-R1 trains one-step and few-step image generators with non-differentiable feedback through surrogate rewards and step-level learning signals.

papers.title: Temporal Difference Learning for Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: A temporal-difference training objective improves diffusion models by encouraging consistent multi-step denoising, with stronger gains for few-step sampling.

papers.title: The Entropic Signature of Class Speciation in Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Tracking semantic entropy reveals when diffusion samples commit to classes and how guidance changes that timing.

papers.title: Training Diffusion Language Models for Black-Box Optimization
papers.tldr: Diffusion language models adapted with structured data and two-stage training achieve state-of-the-art small-data optimization results on Design-Bench.

papers.title: Training-Free Adaptation of Diffusion Models via Doob’s $h$-Transform
papers.tldr: DOIT uses Doob’s h-transform to steer diffusion sampling toward high-reward outputs without retraining or requiring differentiable rewards.

papers.title: Trees to Flows and Back: Unifying Decision Trees and Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: A limiting correspondence between decision trees and diffusion yields a shared optimization principle and practical methods for generation and distillation.

papers.title: UDM-GRPO: Stable and Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization for Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: UDM-GRPO stabilizes reinforcement learning for uniform discrete diffusion models and delivers large reported gains on text-to-image and OCR benchmarks.

papers.title: Unlearning in Diffusion Models: A Unified Framework with KL Divergence and Likelihood Constraints
papers.tldr: Constrained optimization gives diffusion-model unlearning explicit removal targets and improves the trade-off between forgetting and retention.

papers.title: Unsupervised Diffusion Solver for Combinatorial Optimization via Combinatorial Adjoint Matching
papers.tldr: CAM trains discrete diffusion solvers without solution labels by propagating structured optimization signals through their generative trajectories.

papers.title: Value-as-Return: A Two-Stage Framework to Align on the Optimal Score Function
papers.tldr: Value-as-Return aligns diffusion models using learned segment values, with a conditional guarantee of matching a reward-tilted target distribution.

papers.title: Variational Learning for Insertion-based Generation
papers.tldr: The Insertion Process learns token content, insertion position, and stopping jointly, improving generation in evaluated domains without a natural left-to-right order.
